qualification.details: PUC/10+2 completed. Must have written, spoken and reading command over local language. Driver's License and Motorcycle is a must. Preferable 1-3 years' experience with similar job profile with sufficient exposure to the field operations in working with the target population. Freshers are eligible to apply.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Customer Service Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 14th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed PUC or 10+2. Proficiency in the local language is also a mandatory requirement for this role.

faq.question: Q3. Is prior work experience necessary for this position?
faq.answer: While 1-3 years of experience in a similar role is preferable, freshers are also encouraged to apply. The organization values field operations exposure.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely via email. Interested candidates need to send their resume to the specified email address before the closing date.

faq.question: Q5. Do I need a motorcycle and a driving license?
faq.answer: Yes, a valid Driver's License and a Motorcycle are mandatory requirements for all applicants applying for the Customer Service Officer position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a Full Time job opportunity. Candidates selected will be expected to dedicate their full working hours to the role.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by NABARD Financial Services, also known as NABFINS, a prominent financial services organization.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Customer Service Officer recruitment is Nabsfin/OPS/1128. Please refer to this number for any queries.

faq.question: Q10. In which state are the vacancies located?
faq.answer: The Customer Service Officer vacancies are primarily for field work in the state of Chhattisgarh.
